title: callicarpa tomentosa var. longipetiolata
intro: Callicarpa tomentosa var. longipetiolata, commonly known as Purple Bush, is a variety of plant in the Lamiaceae family, known for its vibrant purple flowers and leaves. It has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include wound healing, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, making it useful in the treatment of various skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of Callicarpa tomentosa var. longipetiolata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
